artworks.title: The Embassy to Achilles (Attic red-figure hydria, Munich)
artworks.description: On this Attic red-figure hydria in Munich, Phoenix and Odysseus stand before the sulking Achilles — Iliad 9 made visible. Phoenix is the foster-father whose Meleager parable will fail to move the hero. Staatliche Antikensammlungen.

artworks.title: The Embassy to Achilles (Attic red-figure cup, Louvre G146)
artworks.description: Louvre G146 names the ambassadors of Iliad 9: Phoenix, Ajax, and Odysseus before Achilles in his hut. The old tutor appears as the diplomatic voice Homer gives him — persuasion before the wrath.

artworks.title: Achilles Receiving the Ambassadors of Agamemnon
artworks.description: Ingres' Prix de Rome canvas restages the embassy: Odysseus speaks while Phoenix and Ajax attend Achilles and Patroclus. Neoclassical calm for the tutor who raised the hero and cannot bring him back to battle.

popCulture.title: Phoenix (son of Amyntor)
popCulture.description: Achilles' old tutor on the embassy of Iliad 9 remains the voice of foster-fatherhood — the Meleager paradigm spoken to a sulking hero.
